name: An interview
prompt: A man arrested on the corner last night wants to talk, if it helps him.

choices.text: Send him back to his lawyer

outcome.told: He goes back to his cell. Nothing lost, nothing learned.

choices.text: Hear him out, and check every word

outcome.told: Two of his names check out. The prosecutor takes it from there.

failure.told: None of it checks out. He was buying time, and you gave it to him.
